title: David Huggins' encounters with mantids, grays and a hybrid woman

tellings.quote: And he claimed that the mantids were in charge of these little grays

plain: A man named David Huggins claimed to have had encounters with alien beings, including tall insect-like creatures called mantids, small gray-skinned beings called grays, and a woman who was part human and part alien, in the US South and in underground places. The philosopher Jason Jorjani retells Huggins' claims, saying Huggins described the mantids as being "in charge of these little grays." If taken at face value, it would suggest a ranked order among different kinds of beings.
